title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Fee Splitting
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A local real estate agent frequently refers landlord clients to a paralegal for LTB evictions. The agent asks the paralegal for a 10% "referral fee" for every client they send over. Can the paralegal agree to this arrangement?
options: Yes, as long as the referral fee is disclosed to the client in writing.
Yes, because referral fees are a standard business practice.
No, a paralegal is strictly prohibited from sharing, splitting, or dividing their fees with any person who is not a licensee of the Law Society.
No, referral fees are only permitted if they are less than 5%.
questions.explain: Rule 5.01 (Fee Splitting). A paralegal is prohibited from sharing or dividing a fee with a person who is not a licensee of the LSO. Paying a non-licensee (like a real estate agent) a percentage of legal fees for referrals is professional misconduct.
